form.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Impact Analysis
form.description: What breaks if this changes? Run this BEFORE you approve the change ticket.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | stats count by sourcetype | sort sourcetype

| inputlookup dc_dependencies_lookup | where (dep_type="sourcetype" AND dep_value="$target$") OR (dep_type="dataset" AND like(dep_value,"%|$target$")) | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_tier ko_type enabled | where enabled="yes" | dedup ko_id | stats dc(ko_id) as objects_impacted, dc(eval(if(ko_tier="Tier 0",ko_id,null()))) as tier0_objects

| inputlookup dc_dependencies_lookup | where (dep_type="sourcetype" AND dep_value="$target$") OR (dep_type="dataset" AND like(dep_value,"%|$target$")) | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_tier ko_type enabled | where enabled="yes" | dedup ko_id | stats dc(ko_id) as objects_impacted, dc(eval(if(ko_tier="Tier 0",ko_id,null()))) as tier0_objects

panel.title: Impact by object type and tier

search.query: | inputlookup dc_dependencies_lookup | where (dep_type="sourcetype" AND dep_value="$target$") OR (dep_type="dataset" AND like(dep_value,"%|$target$")) | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_tier ko_type enabled | where enabled="yes" | dedup ko_id | chart count over ko_type by ko_tier

| inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | where sourcetype="$target$" | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen events_24h | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table ae_name uhgid index declared_tier events_24h last_seen technical_owner schema_version contract_status | sort ae_name

panel.title: Every knowledge object that consumes it

search.query: | inputlookup dc_dependencies_lookup | where (dep_type="sourcetype" AND dep_value="$target$") OR (dep_type="dataset" AND like(dep_value,"%|$target$")) | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_name ko_type ko_tier owner app enabled github_repo mitre_technique run_count_30d | where enabled="yes" | dedup ko_id | table ko_tier ko_type ko_name app owner github_repo mitre_technique run_count_30d discovery_method confidence | sort ko_tier - run_count_30d

| inputlookup dc_schema_fields_lookup | where sourcetype="$target$" | table schema_version field_name cim_field data_type required min_coverage_pct sensitivity description | sort schema_version field_name
